segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so Peakline is good with the 36 additional seats if we can keep them at $72 per seat through their current term.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Okay, that coterms to October 31, right? No new paper past that date?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Right, October 31. They want the proposal today so their finance lead can put it on the Thursday approval list.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Do we have services in there, or just licenses?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Just licenses. I had the 36 seats and $2,592 monthly in the pricing sheet yesterday, deal desk has the same end date this morning, and the order form screen is asking for the billing contact before I can send the package.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Billing contact is Nina Patel, accounts payable. invoice@peaklineindustrial.com. They asked for net 30, standard language.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Perfect. No discount exception, then. Their rollout manager said June 10 is the target go-live for the added team.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Yep, and customer success is fine with that date. If you send by three Eastern, I’ll give Peakline a heads-up to watch for it.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll get it out before then and copy you.
